title: yencoding-multi: finish() doc does not mention auto-CRC extraction from add_part()
description: The finish() doc and the lib.rs quick-start example still show manual set_expected_crc32() as the only way to register the expected CRC. Now that add_part() auto-extracts whole_file_crc32, the docs are misleading. Update finish() doc and lib.rs quick-start to explain that CRC from parts is extracted automatically; set_expected_crc32() is only needed for out-of-band CRC (e.g., from NZB file).
